subject.title: fix(agents): unblock router-to-value-agent delegation + fix compaction reconcile TypeError

question: Should an `agents.list` entry plus target-selection permission authorize a parent to trigger tools outside that parent’s resolved tool allowlist, or must that escalation require a separate explicit delegation contract?
rationale: This is a product security boundary, not a mechanical correction: static configuration identifies a target but does not by itself establish that every permitted parent may exercise all of that target’s capabilities through delegated tasks.

options.title: Require explicit delegation authority
options.body: Keep inherited allowlist containment unless configuration adds a narrowly documented opt-in that explicitly authorizes the named parent-to-child capability expansion.

options.title: Accept static-target escalation
options.body: Treat a static `agents.list` target as sufficient operator authorization for its own tool surface and document the resulting parent-to-child authority model.

recommendation.title: Require explicit delegation authority
recommendation.body: Keep inherited allowlist containment unless configuration adds a narrowly documented opt-in that explicitly authorizes the named parent-to-child capability expansion.
